newsitem.title: JAPAN: Wako Sec provides 4.2 bln yen support to unit.
newsitem.headline: Wako Sec provides 4.2 bln yen support to unit.

text.p: Wako Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday that it had provided 4.24 billion yen worth of financial support to its finance unit as part of its already-announced plan to rescue the ailing unit.
Wako said in a statement that the recent implementation of the plan would not affect Wako's earnings as it would sell securities to offset any extraordinary loss stemming from the financial support.
Wako decided in 1995 that it would provide financial support of about 21 billion yen by the end of March 2003 to help the finance unit restructure its business.
